content: {"like": ["Prefers concise, easy-to-watch content that keeps interest without excessive length.", "Enjoys creepy horror that avoids gore and slashers, especially with a doll theme that feels above average.", "Values engaging, well-structured plots that maintain suspense and hold attention.", "Appreciates strong acting and direction, often favoring non-supernatural horror over more intense or surreal films.", "Finds simple, nature-oriented scenes (e.g., watching grass grow) appealing as a form of calm or contrast."], "dislike": ["Dislikes content that is overwhelmingly awful or poorly executed, including stupid or irritating characters and tropes.", "Avoids long runtimes, confusing or nonsensical plots, and endings that lack surprise or resolution.", "Rejects technical frustrations such as tape tangles or VCR removal difficulties, and any form of sacrilege or disrespect in storytelling.", "Prefers not to see negative reviews or ratings, especially on platforms like Amazon, and dislikes films that feel like a setup for a sequel.", "Steers clear of films that are almost unbearable to watch, contain too many unanswered questions, or rely on irritating side characters like cousins or strange agents."]}
